note: Scripture came from the Indian Revised Version (IRV Hindi, irvhin) — the text `language_seed.py` records for this language — fetched whole from the ebible mirror (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/hin_irv/usx). All 66 books, 31,104 verses on disk; section-heading (s/d) paras and trailing editorial cross-references stripped before use.

A `mined` row means an exact byte substring of the IRV of at least 45 characters, measured against the finished chapter body — not a translator's claim. A verse re-personed, re-aimed or shortened below 45 characters is recorded self_rendered, and a translator's own self_rendered flag always stands. `block_index` is a GLOBAL 0-based index over the whole book's blocks (

|||) in chapter order.

The English cites every verse as "(Book C:V, ASV)"; the Hindi drops ", ASV", and the edition notes in the Preface and Appendix D say that this Hindi edition quotes the IRV (the English original uses the ASV of 1901) — the same adaptation the pt edition made for Almeida.
